name: 14626 · Rochester, NY
findings: ZIP 14626 (Rochester) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (65%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14626 (Rochester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14626 (Rochester) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
